\section[śanivār]{\gu{શનિવાર} (śanivār) — Saturday}

\label{lesson:GU-C79-saturday}



\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{શનિવાર}}
\textbf{\gu{શનિવાર}} (\emph{śanivār}) — \textquotedblleft{}Saturday\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for the weekend, tomorrow and yesterday.
\end{grammarlens}
